description: Shared affection (なつき度) model in packages/shared: value domain, all increase/decrease delta rules, clamping, and integration into existing pure actions, plus full unit tests. This is the single source of truth; the frontend/backend (FEAT-002) only consume it. BACKWARD COMPAT is part of this feature: validateMonster must NOT reject pre-#42 saves that lack affection, and a normalize helper defaults it. Independent of FEAT-002's UI; FEAT-002 depends on this.
steps: Add `affection: number` to the Monster interface in packages/shared/src/types.ts with a doc comment: 0..100 (0 = distant, 100 = deeply bonded), raised by care/chat/pet/battle win, lowered by neglect. Note it is OPTIONAL on legacy saves and defaulted on load (reference AFFECTION_INITIAL).

In packages/shared/src/game.ts add exported constants following the existing MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL doc-comment style: AFFECTION_MIN=0, AFFECTION_MAX=100, AFFECTION_INITIAL=20, and named per-action deltas: AFFECTION_GAIN_FEED=2, AFFECTION_GAIN_TRAIN=2, AFFECTION_GAIN_SLEEP=1, AFFECTION_GAIN_CLEAN=2, AFFECTION_GAIN_PET=3, AFFECTION_GAIN_CHAT=1, AFFECTION_GAIN_BATTLE_WIN=5, AFFECTION_DECAY_PER_NEGLECT=1 (applied per TICK beyond a grace period), AFFECTION_PENALTY_STARVING=1 (extra per starving tick). Also add AFFECTION_WARM_THRESHOLD=60 and AFFECTION_COLD_THRESHOLD=20 used to classify tone/level (document that these are the band boundaries).
Add pure helper `clampAffection(value: number): number` that guards non-finite (treat as AFFECTION_INITIAL) and clamps into [AFFECTION_MIN, AFFECTION_MAX], returning an integer (Math.round).
Add pure helper `adjustAffection(current: number, delta: number): number` = clampAffection(current + delta). Used by all delta rules so clamping lives in exactly one place.

Add pure helper `affectionOf(monster): number` that reads monster.affection via clampAffection, defaulting a missing/undefined value to AFFECTION_INITIAL. Use it everywhere a monster's affection is read so legacy saves behave consistently.
Add pure helper `normalizeAffection(monster: Monster): Monster` returning a NEW monster whose affection is affectionOf(monster) (fills in the default for legacy saves). Keep it cheap/idempotent.
Set affection in createMonster to AFFECTION_INITIAL.

Integrate increases into the existing care actions in game.ts: feed +AFFECTION_GAIN_FEED, train +AFFECTION_GAIN_TRAIN, sleep +AFFECTION_GAIN_SLEEP, clean +AFFECTION_GAIN_CLEAN, each via adjustAffection(affectionOf(next), delta) so legacy saves without affection still work. Do NOT change any existing stat/hunger behavior or the returned-NEW-monster contract.

Add a NEW pure action `pet(monster, now = Date.now())` that returns a NEW monster with affection raised by AFFECTION_GAIN_PET (via adjustAffection(affectionOf)) and lastUpdatedAt = now. The DAILY CAP is enforced in the frontend (FEAT-002) via localStorage, so pet() itself is uncapped and purely raises affection (document this boundary in the function's doc comment). Do not add a per-day counter to the Monster type.

Add a pure action `recordBattleWinAffection(monster, now = Date.now())` (or equivalent helper) returning a NEW monster with affection +AFFECTION_GAIN_BATTLE_WIN; the backend battle handler (FEAT-002) calls it on player win. Alternatively expose a generic `gainAffectionFromChat` for chat +AFFECTION_GAIN_CHAT. Pick clear names and export them.

Integrate decay into applyTimePassage: when ticks>0 and the monster is NOT sleeping, decay affection by AFFECTION_DECAY_PER_NEGLECT per tick for neglect, and when hungryLevel has reached MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL (starving) apply an ADDITIONAL AFFECTION_PENALTY_STARVING per tick. Use adjustAffection(affectionOf(next), -total) so it clamps at AFFECTION_MIN and never goes negative. Sleeping does NOT decay affection (resting). Ensure a long offline gap cannot drive affection below AFFECTION_MIN. Keep the existing hunger/dirty/HP/evolution logic unchanged.

Add a classifier `affectionBand(value: number): "cold" | "neutral" | "warm"` using AFFECTION_COLD_THRESHOLD / AFFECTION_WARM_THRESHOLD (value < cold => cold; value >= warm => warm; else neutral). This is reused by the chat prompt tone (FEAT-002) and the UI label. Export it.

BACKWARD COMPAT in validateMonster: treat affection as OPTIONAL. Accept a monster whose `affection` is absent OR is a finite number; REJECT only when affection is present but a non-number/non-finite (e.g. a string). Do NOT add a mandatory affection check that would reject pre-#42 saves. Add a clear doc comment stating the chosen policy (optional-with-default) and why (old localStorage/DynamoDB saves predate #42). The caller (frontend load path, see FEAT-002) runs normalizeAffection to fill the default after validation.

Carry affection into chat context: extend ChatContext (game.ts) with an `affection: number` field and set it in chooseChatContext — from the loaded server monster via affectionOf(loaded) when present, else AFFECTION_INITIAL (client requests don't send affection). Keep the existing stageId/name/fromServer behavior byte-identical. The chat handler (FEAT-002) will read context.affection + affectionBand to pick tone. (If ChatRequest needs no new field, leave the DTO unchanged.)

Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/affection.test.ts following the node:test + node:assert/strict style of game.test.ts. Cover: createMonster sets AFFECTION_INITIAL; clampAffection clamps at BOTH ends and handles non-finite -> AFFECTION_INITIAL and rounds; adjustAffection clamps; affectionOf defaults a missing field and clamps a present one; each care action (feed/train/sleep/clean) raises affection by its exact delta and returns a NEW monster (input unchanged); pet raises by AFFECTION_GAIN_PET; battle-win helper raises by AFFECTION_GAIN_BATTLE_WIN; chat helper raises by AFFECTION_GAIN_CHAT; applyTimePassage decays by AFFECTION_DECAY_PER_NEGLECT per neglect tick, applies the extra starving penalty when hungryLevel is at MAX, does NOT decay while sleeping, and clamps at AFFECTION_MIN over a huge gap; affectionBand returns cold/neutral/warm at the documented boundaries (test the exact threshold values); validateMonster ACCEPTS a monster with affection absent (legacy) AND one with a valid number, and REJECTS one with a non-number affection; normalizeAffection fills the default for a legacy monster and is idempotent. Assert every branch is reachable (both ends of each clamp, each band boundary).
Keep validateMonster's existing checks intact; only ADD the optional affection handling. Run the shared tests and confirm the pre-existing 52 still pass plus the new ones.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` compiles @ddm/shared with no type errors (affection added to Monster + all consumers).
`npm test` passes: the pre-existing 52 shared tests still pass AND the new affection.test.ts tests pass, with count strictly greater than 52.
createMonster returns a monster with affection === AFFECTION_INITIAL.
feed/train/sleep/clean each raise affection by exactly their documented delta and still return a NEW monster without mutating the input.
applyTimePassage decays affection on neglect, applies the extra starving penalty at MAX hunger, never decays below AFFECTION_MIN, and does not decay while sleeping.
validateMonster returns true for a legacy monster object with NO affection field and for one with a valid numeric affection, and false only when affection is present but not a finite number.
normalizeAffection fills AFFECTION_INITIAL for a legacy monster and leaves a valid affection unchanged.
affectionBand returns the documented cold/neutral/warm classification at the threshold boundaries.
ChatContext carries an affection number defaulted to AFFECTION_INITIAL when no server monster is loaded.
verification: Confirm the shared test pass count is strictly greater than the 52 baseline and all new affection assertions pass.
findings: Implemented the shared affection (なつき度) model in packages/shared. types.ts: added optional `affection?: number` to Monster with a doc comment describing the 0..100 domain and legacy-default policy. game.ts: added exported constants (AFFECTION_MIN=0, AFFECTION_MAX=100, AFFECTION_INITIAL=20, per-action deltas GAIN_FEED/TRAIN/SLEEP/CLEAN/PET/CHAT/BATTLE_WIN, DECAY_PER_NEGLECT=1, PENALTY_STARVING=1, WARM_THRESHOLD=60, COLD_THRESHOLD=20) in the MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL doc-comment style. Added pure helpers clampAffection (non-finite -> AFFECTION_INITIAL, Math.round, clamp), adjustAffection, affectionOf (defaults missing/undefined/null to initial), normalizeAffection (new monster, idempotent), affectionBand (cold < COLD_THRESHOLD <= neutral < WARM_THRESHOLD <= warm). Integrated gains into feed/train/sleep/clean via adjustAffection(affectionOf(next), delta). Added new pure actions pet(), recordBattleWinAffection(), gainAffectionFromChat() — all return NEW monster, uncapped (daily pet cap deferred to FEAT-002 frontend). applyTimePassage now decays affection on awake neglect ticks plus an extra starving penalty at MAX hunger, clamped at AFFECTION_MIN; sleeping does not decay. createMonster sets AFFECTION_INITIAL. validateMonster: added OPTIONAL-with-default affection policy (accepts absent or finite number, rejects present-but-non-finite) with doc comment; all existing checks left intact. ChatContext gained an `affection: number` field; chooseChatContext sets it from affectionOf(loaded) or AFFECTION_INITIAL, existing stageId/name/fromServer behavior unchanged. New exports flow via index.ts `export *`. Added packages/shared/src/__tests__/affection.test.ts (23 tests) covering all branches/boundaries. VERIFIED: `npm run build` clean across all packages; `npm test` 75 pass / 0 fail (baseline 52 + 23 new, strictly > 52); frontend helper tests still 63 pass. No new runtime deps. The chat HANDLER tone change, battle.ts win-bump wiring, and all UI belong to FEAT-002.
